rows.grounds: karma as the source of the productive power

items.question: Can the power of karma to produce birth and other results operate without impurity?
premises: Karma possesses a power that produces birth and other results.
This productive power of karma is under consideration as a cause of embodied experience.
The operation of this power is negated in the absence of impurity.
items.inference: Therefore, the power of karma to produce birth and other results requires impurity as a necessary condition.
items.plain_english: The power of karma that produces birth and so forth does not operate without impurity.
